review_finding.counterexample: After a new banner media upload, a PATCH with a title longer than 100 characters returned banner_mutation_invalid before the CAS mutation. The page preserved the uploaded path, so each retry could create another orphan.

source_boundary.owned_media_only: Cleanup receives only uploadedPaths created by the current handleSubmit invocation. Persisted prior media is never passed to this cleanup.

implemented_contract.client_preflight: The trimmed title is required and limited to 100 characters before the first upload call. Exactly 100 characters remains valid; 101 is rejected without upload or mutation dispatch.
implemented_contract.server_authority: AdminBannerMutationError remains authoritative after dispatch. A banner_mutation_invalid response cleans the current operation uploads even if client preflight did not catch the rejection.
implemented_contract.definite_cleanup: Confirmed pre-mutation or zero-row CAS rejections clean all current-operation upload paths and report partial cleanup failure.
implemented_contract.uncertain_preservation: 5xx, invalid-response, transport, and unknown outcomes keep uploaded media so a possibly committed banner cannot be left pointing at deleted media.
implemented_contract.post_upload_client_rejection: If the uploaded media tuple cannot be normalized before mutation dispatch, current-operation paths are also cleaned.
